title: working-capital payment-allocation rule decodes to its six ordered, classified buckets
_note: Parity vector transcribed from the committed capture wc-loan-detail-raw.json (GET /working-capital-loans/1, tenant gerege), cited by WC-02/03/04 and graded by none of them. The capture's paymentAllocation[0] records transactionType "DEFAULT" with paymentAllocationOrder carrying six names IN ORDER: DUE_PENALTY, DUE_FEE, DUE_PRINCIPAL, IN_ADVANCE_PENALTY, IN_ADVANCE_FEE, IN_ADVANCE_PRINCIPAL. This vector pins the DECODE of that observed list: for each name, the name itself, the ApiFacingEnum code, and the two classifications the port derives from the name — due_type (DUE / IN_ADVANCE) and allocation_type (PENALTY / FEE / PRINCIPAL). For this enum the code literal is identical to the name [WorkingCapitalPaymentAllocationType.java: DUE_PENALTY(DUE, PENALTY, "DUE_PENALTY", "Due Penalty")], so code is read from the same observed token; the mapper serialises type.name() [WorkingCapitalLoanPaymentAllocationMapper.java:46], so the wire carries the name, not a separate code. This grades a DECODE/CLASSIFICATION, NOT arithmetic: no money is allocated, summed, rounded or clamped, and the allocation cell carries no money unit. The balance cells are pinned exactly as WC-02 (transcribed from the same capture, not recomputed) so the decode rides the same detail read-back WC-02/03/04 already cite. The rule is graded POSITIONALLY: a port that fills the same six buckets in a different order, or classifies IN_ADVANCE as DUE, or drops a name, fails. The remaining named functions are NOT covered here and that is a property of the observation, not an omission: HumanReadableName ("Due Penalty") is a display string the wire never carries, so grading it would require a synthesised value; JoinAllocationTypes is the write-direction converter and no read-only vector (no POST/PUT) can reach it through Run; unknownAllocationTypeError.Error is the unknown-name arm a known-good observation cannot reach. Six distinct names are observed, so a de-duplicating converter is NOT discriminated and no de-dup drive is promoted.
